notes: New: Rip Packs. A new tab opens booster packs of 15 random songs from all over stepmaniaonline.net. Choose Modern or Vintage charts, pick charters from a list (the ones with popular packs come first) or type their names, set the Expert range, and ask for full difficulty sets if you like, then rip. The cards turn over showing each song's banner, Expert meter, charter and pack. Nothing downloads until you press KEEP: the songs then arrive as a pack of their own, all on one sync. RE-RIP deals a fresh fifteen. Previews, single songs and pack updates now download from a new host, and if the preview server runs out of its monthly allowance the browser tells you instead of failing quietly.
